profile_text.body:
Databricks is a for-profit company founded in 2013 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website describes it as a unified data and AI platform designed to run analytical and operational workloads on a single open, governed foundation, supporting use cases including ETL, data warehousing, business intelligence, and AI application development. The company describes its core architecture around a concept it calls a lakebase, which it positions as merging the transactional characteristics of Postgres with the scale and governance of a data lakehouse, allowing applications, data, and models to operate together without custom ETL pipelines.

On the AI side, Databricks offers DBRX, an open-source large language model built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture and aimed at enterprise training and deployment. Its broader platform includes MLflow for model governance and Unity Catalog for data governance and lineage tracking. The site also describes Databricks Genie, a conversational analytics interface that allows business users to query enterprise data in plain language without SQL or coding, returning text summaries, tabular data, and visualizations. Additionally, the company offers Unity Gateway, described as a multi-AI governance and cost control layer for managing access, spend, and observability across agents, tools, models, and MCP connections from a single governed interface.

The held facts confirm that Databricks maintains an active presence on this site with two tracked products, Databricks DBRX in the Chat and General LLMs category and Databricks AI / DBRX in the Data and Analytics AI category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are noted in the held facts.
